spans.s:
(उ) वञ्च r. 1st cl. (वञ्चति)
To go.
r. 1st and 10th cls. (वञ्चते वञ्चयते)
To delude, to cheat, to trick or deceive.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Fraudulent, crafty.
m. (-कः)
1 A jackal or

A tame or house ichneumon.
3 A rogue, a cheat.
4 A low or vile man.
E.
वञ्च to cheat, ण्वुल् aff.

m. (-थः)
A rogue, a knave, a cheat.
E.
वञ्च to cheat, Uṇādi aff. अथ.

n. (-नं)
Cheating, fraud.
E.
वञ्च to cheat, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be tricked or cheated.
E.
वञ्च to cheat, अनीयर् aff.

ind.
Having cheated.
E.
वञ्च to cheat, क्त्वाच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Tricked, deceived, cheated.
E.
वञ्च to cheat, aff. क्त्र.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Crafty, fraudulent, dishonest.
E.
वञ्च to cheat, aff. उकन्.

mfn. (-ञ्च्या-ञ्च्या-ञ्च्यं)
1 To be gone.
2 To be cheated.
E.
वञ्च to go, यत् aff.

m. (-लः)
1 A tree, (Dalbergia Ougeinensis.)
2 Another tree, (Jonesia Asoca.)
3 Common cane, (Calamus rotang.)
4 A flower, (Hibiscus mutabilis.)
5 A sort of bird.
f. (-ला)
A cow that yields abundance of milk.
E.
वञ्च to go, aff. उलच्, and च changed to ज.

mfn. (-ञ्छन्-ञ्छन्ती-ञ्छत्)
Wishing, desiring.
E.
वाछि to wish, शतृ aff.

n. (-नं)
Desiring, wishing.
E.
वाछि to desire, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Desirable, to be wished for.
E.
वाछि to wish, and अनीयर् aff.; also वाञ्छितव्य and वाच्छ्य.

f. (-ञ्छा)
Wish, desire.
E.
वाच्छि to wish, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Wished, desired.
E.
वाच्छि to wish, क्त aff.

mfn. (-ञ्छी-ञ्छिनी-ञ्छि)
Wishing, desirous.
f. (-ञ्छिनी)
A libidinous woman, a wanton.
E.
वाञ्छा desire, इनि aff.
